title: AI Coding Toolkit Implementation Dataflow
description: Structured representation of an Implementation Dataflow narrative for visualization and evaluation.

stage.description: The activity that produced this implementation dataflow.

userFlows.description: Optional user flows that give context for the implementation dataflow.

variableExposureCount.description: Derived total; null when any inventory is unknown.

changedClassCount.description: Derived number of added, modified, or deleted classes.

changedMethodCount.description: Derived number of added, modified, or deleted methods in changed classes.

changedComponentCount.description: Derived number of added, modified, or deleted UI and external I/O components.

changedDataflowRelationshipCount.description: Derived number of added, modified, or deleted dataflow relationships.

changedStateUpdateRelationshipCount.description: Derived number of added, modified, or deleted state-update relationships.

classes.description: Implementation classes represented by the document. Class and component names must be unique across the document.

components.description: User-facing UI surfaces and external I/O endpoints represented by the document. Use an empty array when none are represented.

relationships.description: Direct relationships between represented entities. Preserve intermediate participants and include a state relationship for every represented state read or write. Relationships express dependencies and data movement, not execution order.

changeType.description: How an entity or relationship differs from the existing architecture. Use added for a new entry, modified for a changed declaration, responsibility, contract, or relationship, deleted for a removed entry, and unchanged for an existing entry reused without such a change. Participation or a new connection alone does not modify an endpoint.

userFlow.description: Whether this entry lies on a documented user-flow path from a user action to persisted state or an output. Setup and ownership alone do not qualify.

userFlowSet.description: One user flow with its numbered steps.

name.description: Names this user flow; unique across user flows.

id.description: The step's position within its user flow, starting at 1.

text.description: The user-flow step. Conditional branches and loops stay in this text.

component.description: A user-facing UI surface or external I/O endpoint. Represent implementation classes, methods, handlers, and adapters as classes and methods instead.

name.description: Unique across classes and components; referenced by relationship endpoints.

type.description: A user-facing UI surface or an external I/O endpoint such as a network service, file, or browser storage.

class.description: An implementation class represented by the document.

methods.description: Methods represented for this class. Method names must be unique within the class.

stateVariables.description: Mutable instance fields whose declaration or architectural meaning is added, modified, or deleted, plus unchanged mutable fields referenced by a state-read or state-update relationship. Excludes static or class variables, local variables, unrelated fields, explicitly read-only fields, fields initialized at declaration or construction but never written afterward, and fields used only as references to owned child objects. Constructor assignment is initialization rather than a state update. Runtime writes do not by themselves make an existing field modified. State-variable names must be unique within the class.

variableExposureCount.description: Derived class count; null when its inventory is unknown.

variableExposure.description: Existing declarations exposed to this class's changes; null when the inventory is required but not yet known.

method.description: An implementation method represented for its class.

stateVariable.description: A mutable instance field represented for its class. State relationships reference the exact state-variable entry.

method.description: Existing method containing the parameter or local.

file.description: Canonical repository-relative path to the declaration in current code.

classEndpoint.description: References a class by its document-unique name.

methodEndpoint.description: References a method by its class name and class-local method name.

stateVariableEndpoint.description: References a state variable by its class name and class-local state-variable name.

componentEndpoint.description: References a component by its document-unique name.

dataflowEndpoint.description: A method or component that directly sends or receives data.

oneOf.description: A direct data transfer between method or component endpoints. Record request and response paths as separate relationships.
A method reads a value from mutable instance state; the state variable is the source and the method is the target.
A method writes mutable instance state; the method is the source and the state variable is the target.
A class owns a child class. A field used only for this ownership is represented by composition rather than as a state variable.

relationship.description: A direct architectural relationship between two represented endpoints.

from.description: Explicit source reference, constrained by relationship type.

to.description: Explicit target reference, constrained by relationship type.

dataDescription.description: What data this relationship transfers, reads, or modifies.

purpose.description: Why this relationship is needed. On a user-flow relationship, its role in the flow, naming a step where one depends on it; otherwise why the relationship exists at all.
